title: Michael Smith — Digital interactions
features: Timed Design/Create/Inspire loading sequence with rAF counter and progress, reduced-motion bypass, blue-ring floating navigation, original animated orbital line artwork, cycling roles, filterable work list, resume dialog/download and validated local contact flow.
limitations: Approved static HTML/CSS/JS adaptation replaces Next.js, GSAP and Framer Motion. Original SVG orbital artwork replaces the unverified HLS stream and unspecified AVIF poster; system Georgia and Arial replace remote fonts. Michael Smith, JA monogram, resume and work are fictional prompt content. Contact is a local demo without message delivery. Normal-motion loader and role cycling are independently browser-tested.
